changes.summary: Removed illegal non-forced completion from TryScheduleAbyssalPath, deferred StringPullPathJob readback to CompleteAbyssalPathJob, copied live A* threat grid/voxel plus smoothing voxel/passability inputs into TempJob snapshots, degraded optional smoothing overlays instead of force-completing an in-flight pathSourceHandle, and added continuous quality-scaled smoothing budgets.

Copied live VegetationEcosystemThreatGrid DataVault views into TempJob snapshots before scheduling ThreatPropagationJob and BuildAbyssalFlowFieldJob; pending release now owns PreviousThreat and ThreatGridSnapshot.

Moved scheduled GPR raymarch writes out of live DataVault buffers into RadarPendingJob TempJob staging arrays; publish now happens after DispatcherJobFence.TryComplete through short TryAcquireWriteLock calls released in a finally block.
Extended threat and flow pending structs with NativeArray<float> snapshot ownership fields for cross-frame DataVault-safe job inputs.
Removed hidden non-forced HLOD completion from TryGetVisibleHLODPayload and RebuildHLODRegistrySnapshot; read accessor and SlowTick rebuild path no longer complete jobs outside the dispatcher gate.
Added AbyssalPathPendingJob payload storage and _abyssalPathJob field so async path jobs retain native outputs and copied inputs until the dispatcher completion window.

Extended static source-contract tests to cover VegetationNavGridSynchronizer, abyssal path deferred completion, A* threat snapshot ownership, threat/flow current threat grid snapshots, GPR staging/write-lock publish, absence of ForceCompleteAbyssalPathDependency, and continuous GlobalQualityWeight budget use.

dataSovereignty.jobLifetimeProtection: Threat propagation now reads a copied TempJob PreviousThreat snapshot. Flow-field solving now reads a copied TempJob ThreatGridSnapshot. Abyssal A* now reads copied TempJob snapshots for ecosystem threat grid and threat voxels. Abyssal smoothing reads copied TempJob snapshots for nav passability and ecosystem threat voxels. GPR raymarch reads/writes RadarPendingJob TempJob staging arrays instead of live DataVault views, then publishes under short write locks after dispatcher completion. Optional smoothing overlay snapshot failures degrade to default inputs instead of force-completing the in-flight pathSourceHandle.
